company.shortDescription: Cadence is a healthcare technology company that provides remote patient care and chronic disease management services.
company.description: Cadence is a healthcare technology company that provides remote patient care and chronic disease management services for health systems and providers. It operates a clinical AI-driven platform that monitors patients at home and supports ongoing treatment for conditions such as hypertension, diabetes, and heart failure through connected devices, data tracking, and clinician-led care workflows. The company’s model centers on continuous monitoring of patient vitals like blood pressure, weight, symptoms, and medication adherence, with data flowing into a clinical intelligence system that flags risks and supports early intervention.
